body:
Found at sign-off of #590 (PR #638), recorded in that bundle's §10. Not fixed there.

The comment at `template/src/pdca_harness/flow.py:1868-1871` (on `fix/590-flow-dep-on-seed-child-refused`) still says the named batch is levelled strictly "exactly as before" and that "adoption never relaxes it". After #590 that isn't true: a child offered by a recovery seed now relaxes the strict check.

**Fix:** reword the comment to describe the #590 behaviour. This is a comment-only change. It can ride on PR #638 if that PR is still open when someone picks this up.

Source: `results/issue_590/SUMMARY.md` §10 (pdca-pdca).
title: flow: stale comment at flow.py:1868-1871 says adoption never relaxes the strict levelling (no longer true after #590)
